name: benchmark_lora
description: benchmark_lora evaluates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning performance across tasks to measure parameter-efficient adaptation of pretrained models. It compares task performance and efficiency (trainable parameters, memory) when using LoRA adapters on common downstream tasks. The benchmark is intended for practitioners assessing trade-offs between fine-tuning cost and task accuracy.
evaluation_method: task-dependent metrics (accuracy / F1 / BLEU) combined with parameter-efficiency (fraction of trainable params)
reputation: A practical, implementation-focused benchmark used by practitioners exploring parameter-efficient fine-tuning; modest community visibility compared to large standardized benchmarks.
